Definition: from G1537 and G5562; to depart:--depart out.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to depart out, to leave a place, and Jesus uses it once, in His warning about Jerusalem. When you see the city compassed with armies, He says, let those in the midst of it depart out, and let those in the country not enter in. The word is a plain order to leave before the judgement falls.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus warns because He loves, and His order to leave Jerusalem was mercy before the judgement, not cruelty after it.
